name: ui-runtime-set-control-value
description: Set Play Mode runtime control value on uGUI or UI Toolkit targets (Slider, Toggle, Dropdown, enum, etc.). Resolve by path/instanceId or screen position. Requires Play Mode. Use ui-runtime-type-text for text fields.

framework.description: Target framework. auto (default) resolves across registered frameworks; ugui/uitoolkit force one.

x.description: Screen x for hit-test resolution. Bottom-left origin; pixels or 0..1 when isNormalized is true.

y.description: Screen y for hit-test resolution. Bottom-left origin; pixels or 0..1 when isNormalized is true.

isNormalized.description: When true, x/y are normalized bottom-left coordinates.

path.description: uGUI transform path, UI Toolkit VisualElement path, or visualElementRef (ve:...).

value.description: Control value. Toggle accepts true/false/0/1; Slider/Scrollbar numbers; Dropdown index or option text; enum name or index; InputField/DropdownField strings.
